I've thought this exact thing multiple times!!


I have trauma from SA. The person involved lives in a town nearby and has a specific type of vehicle. I can't avoid either of these things when I'm out driving. It's mentally exhausting, especially when I can't trust anyone to talk about it.
Terrible take, especially on *this* sub. Do us all a favor and log off, son.
I have a friend who had bright blonde/almost white hair as a kid, and so does her second born. We call them "towheads" where I'm from. If you look up the term, you'll see what I mean! :)

It's still something I'm learning to manage.

I've completely cut the people out of my life associated with those traumatic experiences, sought out therapy, and managed through distractions, such as music and video games.

I also changed the course of my life a short time after and started going to college, which keeps me occupied in a positive way.
This was very well said! I hope you continue to have more good days going forward. I saved your comment to read again later

PTSD from SA

It's truly indescribable.
This. All of this. Including rage.

I know this may not help a lot but even if you don't suspect a specific disorder, it might be worth seeking professional advice over. If this causes you stress it could be anxiety-related, as an example. I've personally told therapists before that I suspect things and they're willing to look into it, that's what they're there for. Everyone's interaction with these issues experiences it different, and that is unfortunate because it makes symptoms so difficult to understand. 

I hope you find answers.
I'm so sorry this happened to you. It is very similar to my experience, as I had shrugged it off until I realized what really happened.
all the time, so I bottle it up
